'''Chloe Sedesi''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Cinder Dock''' in the '''Shenve''' system of the Witch Head region. A former apprentice to [[Professor Palin]], she is discovered independently through '''[[Marco Qwent]]''' and works on Thrusters and Frame Shift Drives.<ref name="inara-chloe">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/25/ Chloe Sedesi — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-chloe">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Chloe_Sedesi Chloe Sedesi], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Her workshop provides '''Grade 5 Thruster engineering''' and '''Grade 3 Frame Shift Drive engineering'''.<ref name="inara-chloe" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Shenve
* '''Facility:''' Cinder Dock
* '''Region:''' Witch Head
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules
* '''Referral required:''' [[Marco Qwent]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

Cinder Dock lies outside the core inhabited Bubble, so reaching Chloe requires additional travel after her invitation conditions have been met.

== Access requirements ==

Chloe's direct access conditions are:<ref name="inara-chloe" />

# Reach Grade 3 access and progress approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[Marco Qwent]].
# Reach a maximum distance of at least '''5,000 light-years from the Commander's career start location'''.
# Obtain '''25 Sensor Fragments'''.
# Provide all 25 fragments at Cinder Dock.

The distance requirement uses the greatest distance reached from the career start location; it is not a cumulative total of hyperspace travel. Once that maximum-distance statistic reaches 5,000 light-years, returning toward the Bubble does not erase the qualification.

Sensor Fragments are Manufactured Engineering materials rather than commodities. They use material storage and do not require 25 tonnes of cargo space.

For route planning, checking the distance statistic, collecting Sensor Fragments, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Chloe Sedesi]].

{{Field note|Marco's referral reveals Chloe. The 5,000-light-year qualification and Sensor Fragment contribution remain separate requirements.}}

== Relationship to Professor Palin ==

Chloe and [[Professor Palin]] are parallel referrals from [[Marco Qwent]], not sequential unlocks. Both provide Grade 5 Thruster and Grade 3 Frame Shift Drive engineering, and both use the same 5,000-light-year meeting threshold and a separate contribution of 25 Sensor Fragments.<ref name="inara-chloe" /><ref name="inara-palin">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/3/ Professor Palin — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Unlocking either Engineer does not unlock the other or satisfy the other's Sensor Fragment contribution.

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Chloe increases by:<ref name="inara-chloe" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling exploration data at Cinder Dock.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Chloe supports. Exploration data gathered while meeting the distance requirement can be sold at Cinder Dock after access is available. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-chloe" />

== Engineering services ==

Chloe's maximum grade is specific to each module family.<ref name="inara-chloe" /><ref name="edwiki-chloe" />

{| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;"
! Module
! Maximum grade
|-
| [[Thrusters]]
| '''Grade 5'''
|-
| [[Frame Shift Drive]]
| '''Grade 3'''
|}

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. Chloe can apply compatible Experimental Effects to both module families, including to a Frame Shift Drive carrying a higher blueprint grade from another Engineer.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Chloe blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed her Grade 5 Thruster or Grade 3 Frame Shift Drive limit, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Referrals ==

Chloe does not currently introduce another Engineer in the ship Engineer referral network. Her relationship to Marco Qwent, Professor Palin, and the wider network can be viewed in the [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
